advancements.echorecovery.root.title: ECHO: Recovery
Recover your belongings from a grave.
index.echorecovery.category.title: Recovery
index.echorecovery.category.desc: Protected graves, field caches, recovery tools, and death recovery rules.
index.echorecovery.graves.title: Graves and Field Caches
index.echorecovery.graves.subtitle: Protected item recovery
index.echorecovery.graves.summary: Deaths create a recoverable grave/cache by default.
index.echorecovery.graves.body: Recovery stores items in protected graves or field caches, keeps the default experience forgiving, and uses commands, compass guidance, Lens, HoloMap, and Terminal surfaces when available.
index.echorecovery.grave_key.title: Grave Key
index.echorecovery.grave_key.subtitle: Bound access helper
index.echorecovery.grave_key.summary: Keys can bind to a specific grave and satisfy key-required access modes.
index.echorecovery.grave_key.body: When key-required mode is enabled, matching bound keys grant access to the cache they reference. Wrong keys report a clear lock message.
index.echorecovery.recovery_compass.summ: The compass reports the nearest active grave, distance, dimension, and signal state.
index.echorecovery.recovery_compass.body: By default the compass tracks same-dimension graves. Cross-dimensional status is explicit and can be enabled by config.
index.echorecovery.rules.title: Recovery Rules
index.echorecovery.rules.subtitle: Datapack item handling
index.echorecovery.rules.summary: Item rules decide whether stacks are soulbound, protected, dropped, destroyed, or kept out of graves.
index.echorecovery.rules.body: Rules load from data/<namespace>/echorecovery/recovery_rule and are applied after local providers and before default tag handling.
index.echorecovery.presets.title: Recovery Presets
index.echorecovery.presets.subtitle: Config defaults
index.echorecovery.presets.summary: Presets describe intended server profiles without overwriting explicit config unless selected.
index.echorecovery.presets.body: The default forgiving profile protects graves, disables expiration and remote recovery, and keeps cross-dimensional compass tracking off.
